translation_notes: Both self.shaclNS and self.rdfSyntax store the Namespace OBJECT itself on self (reused later by other methods of the class, outside this region), not just its terms: each needs `as NAME` so the bound Python name can be assigned back to the attribute (`self.shaclNS = SHACL_NS`), unlike a namespace used only through attribute access.

driver.py: __init__ is extracted as a bare function, so `self` is a small stand-in object with value-based __eq__ (Graph attributes compared by isomorphism). self.random_number is excluded from that equality on purpose: it is 1000 fresh random.randint draws per call, not RDF content, and comparing exact values would fail on non-determinism unrelated to the translation.
